name: Castellammare di Stabia (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castellammare di Stabia (a castle on the sea beneath the Madonna) within branches, with the inscription CITTA' DI CASTELLAMMARE DI STABIA in blue arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Castellammare di Stabia, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Castellammare di Stabia arms — castle on the sea beneath the Madonna, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTA' DI CASTELLAMMARE DI STABIA arched above the arms
